石蕊遇碱变蓝，遇中性溶液仍为紫色。: Litmus turns blue with a base and stays purple in a neutral solution.
无色酚酞试液遇到碱会变成什么颜色？: What colour does colourless phenolphthalein solution turn when it meets a base?
酚酞遇酸和中性溶液不变色。: Phenolphthalein does not change colour with acids and neutral solutions.

酸和碱反应生成盐和水，叫做？: What is it called when an acid and a base react to form a salt and water?
用熟石灰改良酸性土壤就是中和反应。: Using slaked lime to improve acidic soil is a neutralisation reaction.

碳酸钠俗名叫什么？: What is the common name of sodium carbonate?
碳酸钠虽叫“碱”，其实是盐。: Although sodium carbonate is called an "alkali", it is actually a salt.
碳酸氢钠俗名叫什么？: What is the common name of sodium hydrogencarbonate?

氢氧化钙俗名叫什么？: What is the common name of calcium hydroxide?

氧化钙俗名叫什么？: What is the common name of calcium oxide?

大理石、石灰石的主要成分是？: What is the main component of marble and limestone?

食盐的主要成分是？: What is the main component of table salt?
氯化钠的化学式是 NaCl。: The chemical formula of sodium chloride is NaCl.
天然气的主要成分是？: What is the main component of natural gas?
甲烷的化学式是 CH₄。: The chemical formula of methane is CH₄.
煤气中毒的元凶是？: What is the culprit in gas poisoning?
一氧化碳无色无味，会让血液无法运输氧气。: Carbon monoxide is colourless and odourless and stops the blood from carrying oxygen.
金刚石和石墨都是由什么元素组成的？: What element do diamond and graphite both consist of?

不纯的氢气遇火可能会爆炸。: Impure hydrogen may explode when it meets a flame.
所以氦气被用来充气球和飞艇。: So helium is used to fill balloons and airships.

金属活动性顺序中，最靠前（最活泼）的是下面哪个？: In the activity series of metals, which of these is nearest the front (the most reactive)?
钾、钙、钠能和冷水剧烈反应。: Potassium, calcium and sodium react violently with cold water.
下列金属不能与稀盐酸反应的是？: Which of these metals does NOT react with dilute hydrochloric acid?
排在氢前面的金属才能置换出酸中的氢。: Only metals above hydrogen can displace hydrogen from an acid.

铁丝在氧气中燃烧的生成物是？: What is the product when an iron wire burns in oxygen?

镁条在空气中燃烧的现象是？: What is seen when a magnesium strip burns in air?

照明弹、烟花里用到镁。: Magnesium is used in flares and fireworks.
硫在氧气中燃烧发出什么颜色的火焰？: What colour of flame does sulfur give when burning in oxygen?

过滤可以除去水中的什么？: What can filtration remove from water?

活性炭在净水中的作用是？: What is the role of activated carbon in water purification?
活性炭多孔，表面积很大。: Activated carbon is porous and has a very large surface area.

少烧煤和石油、多种树可以缓解。: Burning less coal and oil and planting more trees can help.

氟利昂会破坏臭氧层。: Freons (CFCs) can destroy the ozone layer.

一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。: A water molecule is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

一个二氧化碳分子由一个碳原子和两个氧原子构成。: A carbon dioxide molecule is made of one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms.

书写方程式要配平，让两边原子数相等。: Equations must be balanced so that the numbers of atoms on both sides are equal.

植物细胞有而动物细胞没有的结构是？: What structures do plant cells have that animal cells do not?
所以植物细胞更“硬”，还能进行光合作用。: So plant cells are "harder" and can also carry out photosynthesis.
细胞中控制生物遗传的结构是？: Which structure in the cell controls heredity?
细胞核里有染色体，染色体上有 DNA。: The nucleus holds chromosomes, and the chromosomes carry DNA.

光合作用的产物是？: What are the products of photosynthesis?

呼吸作用主要在细胞的哪里进行？: Where in the cell does respiration mainly take place?

呼吸作用的实质是？: What is the essence of respiration?

鸟类适于飞行的特点是？: What features make birds suited to flight?
身体呈流线型、骨骼中空、有气囊: A streamlined body, hollow bones and air sacs

两栖动物幼体和成体分别用什么呼吸？: What do the young and the adult of amphibians breathe with?

缺碘容易患？: A lack of iodine easily causes...
